classes.purpose: Explicit operator-issued private-test inclusion for one account/project, feature, operation and interval. Not authentication, customer approval, provider consent or a subscription.
classes.currentRetention: Immutable metadata retained under account/project after expiry or one-way revocation to prevent request-ID recreation. No age purge. Quotas bound lifetime row count; account/project deletion cascades.
classes.proposedRetention: Ordinary account/project closure purges scoped test grants after admissions stop. Preserve only a separately justified minimal unresolved-operation identity; grants never survive export/restore as transferable authority.
classes.deletionAuthority: Operator may revoke; only reviewed parent cleanup removes retained rows. Models and customer jobs cannot issue, refresh or remove grants.
classes.exportPolicy: Allowlist scope, feature, operation, interval and revoked status. Exclude internal operator review references. Never export a grant as authority for another account or deployment.

readers: Owner status and restricted operator grant management; exact account/project/feature/operation scope
processors: Shared inclusion resolver and current domain admission; no model may create a grant
remainingExposure: Grant metadata can reveal commercial access and operator decisions.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Identify the account and its recorded US customer declaration.
classes.currentRetention: Retained while the account exists; eligibility cascades. Other tables can prevent account deletion.
classes.proposedRetention: Active account; ordinary personal fields enter closure purge. Only justified minimal proof survives in a separate restricted receipt.
classes.deletionAuthority: Recently authenticated owner confirms exact account closure; restricted preservation review precedes purge.
classes.exportPolicy: Allowlist account identifier, email, creation time and US customer declaration. Account rows have no password fields.

readers: Current owner/profile handlers; restricted authentication and eligibility service
processors: Identity engine; no email/customer declaration in routine model context
remainingExposure: Email and jurisdiction declaration are readable personal data; operator access must be restricted.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Current policy epoch, verified enrollment/recovery progress and public passkey verification material. Private passkey keys are never received.
classes.currentRetention: Account-owned cascades. Pending verified progress is retained until authenticated cancellation or reviewed account deletion. Attempts referenced by credentials are retained; emergency removal fences all authority.
classes.proposedRetention: Preserve monotonic revocation and generation truth during any forward repair. Never restore historical sessions or an earlier kit verifier. Whole-account restore is not implemented.
classes.deletionAuthority: Shared identity engine handles reviewed cancellation/removal; complete account closure remains a separate lifecycle gate.
classes.exportPolicy: Allowlist stage, user-facing credential names and creation/last-use metadata. Exclude public keys, credential IDs, counters, kit verifiers and internal proof identifiers.

readers: Restricted enrollment/recovery handlers and current owner credential controls
processors: Identity ceremony/admission engine; no model context
remainingExposure: Credential IDs/public keys and progress are sensitive metadata even though private passkey keys are absent.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Hashed ordinary sessions, restricted grants and one-use browser ceremonies.
classes.currentRetention: Expiry denies authority immediately. Daily maintenance removes at most 500 expired rows per table. Sessions last at most seven days from proof, grants thirty minutes, challenges five minutes. User deletion explicitly clears bound challenges; credential/account deletion cascades sessions/grants.
classes.proposedRetention: Retain only current authority; any restore must discard these records and require fresh verification. Never rehydrate browser sessions from backups.
classes.deletionAuthority: Verified logout, shared revocation engine and bounded expiry maintenance.
classes.exportPolicy: No bearer hashes, tokens, challenges, challenge payloads, proof bodies or authority IDs in customer exports, Chat or telemetry.

readers: One-use ceremony and exact ordinary/restricted session handlers
processors: Identity verification, revocation and bounded expiry maintenance; no inference
remainingExposure: Bearer material exists in browser/request memory; readable proof metadata and backups must not re-create authority.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: One-time kit preparation and explicit saved acknowledgment; stores a verifier, never the plaintext kit.
classes.currentRetention: Offers expire after thirty minutes; daily maintenance deletes at most 500 expired offers. Active kit verifier stays on identity_accounts until rotation/removal.
classes.proposedRetention: No recovery-key plaintext or verifier is exported/restored as transferable authority. Preserve current kit generation and revocation truth in forward repair.
classes.deletionAuthority: Shared kit preparation supersedes the prior offer; exact saved acknowledgment and reviewed rotation/completion activate it.
classes.exportPolicy: Allowlist saved/expiry metadata only. Exclude verifiers and nonce/request bindings. Plaintext delivery exists only in its original no-store preparation response.

readers: Exact recent-authenticated or restricted kit ceremony; original no-store response recipient
processors: Kit generation/verification and explicit save acknowledgment; no model context
remainingExposure: Customer-held print/download copies can outlive server rotation; copied old codes remain invalid.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Bound operation receipts prevent duplicate identity effects; recovery reviews preserve exact lost-credential choices and progress.
classes.currentRetention: Ceremony/effect receipts last seven days with bounded 500-row expiry cleanup. Reviews follow their attempts/account and are not silently purged during pending recovery. Receipts cannot issue fresh bearer authority on replay.
classes.proposedRetention: Retain only the evidence necessary for current progress and unresolved effects. Restored receipts cannot re-create expired or revoked authority.
classes.deletionAuthority: Shared engine creates immutable receipts and revises exact reviews. Account cleanup cascades; bounded cleanup applies only to expired operation receipts.
classes.exportPolicy: Allowlist user-facing completion/progress status. Exclude request hashes, execution nonces, review credential IDs and internal proof bindings.

readers: Current scoped identity readback and restricted operator recovery
processors: Identity commit/replay logic; no model context
remainingExposure: Receipts expose identity chronology and cannot be treated as credentials after restoration.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Single-use signup invitations, including spent invitations whose account was removed.
classes.currentRetention: used_at is immutable after redemption. User deletion clears used_by but leaves spending intact. There is no invitation age purge that could resurrect a spent code.
classes.proposedRetention: Operator retention may remove expired code hashes only without allowing old codes to be reissued. Do not restore historical invitation availability.
classes.deletionAuthority: Operator creates invitations; signup atomically spends one; the database preserves spent status through cancellation/deletion.
classes.exportPolicy: No invitation code or code hash in customer exports or logs.

readers: Possessing invite holder through bounded signup; operator issuance
processors: Single-use invitation admission; no model context
remainingExposure: Invite plaintext is holder/operator material; historical spent rows must not become reusable.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Always-empty SQL assertion table used to atomically reject workspace batches after identity revocation.
classes.currentRetention: No records: a successful assertion inserts zero rows; any attempted row insertion aborts its entire transaction.
classes.proposedRetention: Remain empty in every deployment and restore.
classes.deletionAuthority: Database trigger; never application CRUD or an operator grant.
classes.exportPolicy: No data exists to export.

readers: Internal SQL assertion mechanism; no customer data API
processors: Atomic admission predicates only
remainingExposure: The table must remain empty; a successful SQL assertion is not a reusable capability.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Profile/name/bio/photo, welcome progress, saved workspace tabs and preferences.

classes.proposedRetention: Retain while active or until explicit replacement/removal; ordinary closure purge includes agent-context copies. Pending/blocked images follow restricted safety review, never ordinary export.

protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Conversation continuity, saved agent inspection results, action history and metadata proving that a specific review was presented in a Chat reply.

classes.proposedRetention: Retain active-account conversation until an approved user removal/retention policy; ordinary closure purge includes inspections and copied context. Extract only necessary unresolved-operation metadata first.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner closure or future reviewed conversation deletion; do not delete referenced authority/operation evidence without migration.
classes.exportPolicy: Saved user/assistant turns and customer action summaries at a stable cutoff. Exclude private operator material and internal inspection dumps.

readers: Current owner transcript/history/export and exact review presentation
processors: Maintenance model receives selected relevant history/inspection; class-specific protected reads and content-free diagnostics
remainingExposure: Turns and saved inspections may contain private content and recovery outcomes; customer copies and selected model processing remain separate exposure.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Immutable site artifacts, publication authority, comparisons and removal receipts.
classes.currentRetention: Up to 25 saved versions; exact removal reviews, live/review/backup dependency guards, no automatic age pruning. Applied removal metadata prevents same-ID recreation.
classes.proposedRetention: Active content until explicit removal/closure; keep non-content deletion tombstones independently of the deleted account and every restore candidate. Unpublish before purge.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact owner version/project/account review; check live and external-backup dependencies at commit time.
classes.exportPolicy: Owned source/config/HTML and provenance, subject to current content/media clearance. Export is not automatic publication permission.

readers: Owner private previews/diffs/exports; public host only exact admitted publications
processors: Compiler/rendering, exact review/publication and selected owner edits
remainingExposure: Published bytes and exported archives can be copied externally; private previous versions must remain owner-scoped.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Full private website/service configuration, compiler locks, manifests, target references, previews, release candidates and comparison copies, including forward-restored snapshots.
classes.currentRetention: Proposals expire after ten minutes; preparing another proposal clears expired project proposals and a bounded global batch. Expiry is not a timed purge. Saved full snapshots have count/byte bounds, not age expiry. Exact website removal cascades dependent full snapshots and removes associated proposal/comparison copies; current heads and unexpired unapplied/activation reviews retain dependencies. Current Chat comparison reads are private/no-store, opened on demand and never persisted in sessionStorage, transcript exports or inference context. Their owner/review/digest/revision-scoped query has zero inactive retention; collapse/navigation/account reset clears it, and failed or refreshing reads hide earlier facts. The existing protected preview and exact approval remain separate.
classes.proposedRetention: Retain active saved configurations until exact removal or closure. Enumerate every full snapshot, proposal, preview, comparison and Chat/inspection copy during erasure. Restore creates a forward version under current safety and ownership checks; deleted bytes cannot be recreated from metadata receipts.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact owner website/project/account review and current dependency/hold checks. Direct retained-head or review deletion is not a supported bypass; eligible parent cascades do not constitute a customer closure workflow.
classes.exportPolicy: Allowlist owned cleared configurations, pinned compiler/version provenance and compatible artifacts. Label private desired settings separately from enabled services; exclude internal envelopes/authority digests, visitor records and credentials. Current whole-account export remains unimplemented.

readers: Owner exact proposal/version/configuration handlers; published outputs through separate serving gates
processors: Current compiler, comparison/restore and selected maintenance inspection
remainingExposure: Full specifications and private previews are readable; a compiler manifest does not grant publication authority.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Immutable private-save receipts, current revision pointers, exact Chat presentation links and metadata provenance for separately confirmed contact/form activation reviews.
classes.currentRetention: Creation/apply/activation receipts retain IDs, digests, revisions and target metadata independently of full saved bytes. Receipt/head deletion is guarded while parents exist; eligible parent cascades remove them. Presentation links follow their turn/proposal/review. No terminal-receipt age purge; short review expiry is not erasure. Existing service review constraints still apply.
classes.proposedRetention: Preserve minimum replay and unresolved-effect identity before erasing content, then use an approved metadata schedule. Extract independent restore suppression before account/project cascades; current same-database tombstones cannot suppress an older database restore. Minimize expired operational targets after dependent operations settle.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact owner lifecycle review coordinated with existing service withdrawal and unresolved-operation reconciliation. Neither Chat links nor private saves authorize activation; historical receipts cannot reactivate after a disable or restore erased configuration.
classes.exportPolicy: Allowlist customer-visible save/activation status, time and version provenance. Exclude internal target envelopes, authority hashes and operational reference graphs. No source, form submissions or visitor data are stored in these metadata receipts.

readers: Current owner exact review/readback handlers; internal guarded commits
processors: Version/revision/receipt admission and serving eligibility; model can prepare but cannot confirm
remainingExposure: Historical approvals and restored pointers cannot authorize a new effect or obsolete configuration.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Private project JPEG metadata/reference graph and queued physical R2 cleanup.
classes.currentRetention: Referenced photos retained; reviewed unused-photo removal queues object keys. Daily cleanup waits one hour and uses a bounded orphan pass. file_cleanup has no owner FK.
classes.proposedRetention: Retain referenced approved objects until removal/closure. Keep a private owner/object deletion manifest until R2 deletion and orphan reconciliation are confirmed; no ordinary export of held media.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner exact photo/closure review plus safety hold check; worker performs only previously authorized object cleanup.
classes.exportPolicy: Approved JPEG bytes and safe metadata only; do not expose R2 keys, held content or scanner references.

readers: Owner exact object reads only after current safety approval; public bytes only through approved publication
processors: Bounded JPEG envelope/metadata preparation, private storage and queued deletion; scanner processing remains unconfigured/deferred
remainingExposure: Readable object body/name/digest and public copies; object-key possession alone is not permission. Metadata removal is not content clearance.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Exact-byte policy requirements, approval expiry and scanner-attempt identity.
classes.currentRetention: Bounded ledgers; expiry blocks serving but is not physical cleanup. Owner/file cascades and profile replacement can remove evidence. No restricted preservation store or live scanner.
classes.proposedRetention: Retain current decisions while the artifact can be used; terminal routine checks get a reviewed 90-day metadata schedule. Open cases/unknown scans move to restricted handling before ordinary deletion.
classes.deletionAuthority: Dedicated lifecycle/safety operator; a model verdict, owner closure or low risk score cannot release a legal preservation hold.
classes.exportPolicy: Customer-facing availability/decision summaries where permitted; no authority hashes, detector internals, restricted evidence or suspected-illegal bytes.

readers: Current gated media/content admission and restricted trusted-result path
processors: Existing recorded decision/risk gates and ticket validation; scanner execution deferred
remainingExposure: Policy outcomes and evidence references are sensitive; no detector coverage or retained-content legality claim from metadata.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Reviewed incident provenance and immutable corrections used for risk sampling.
classes.currentRetention: No age purge; ordinary scoring decay does not delete evidence. Account cascade currently removes rows. No independent legal-hold store.
classes.proposedRetention: Routine closed-case metadata: proposed 90 days after resolution, subject to counsel/privacy review. Statutory/legal cases: case-specific basis, scope, deadline and extension; no blanket permanent retention.
classes.deletionAuthority: Named restricted case operator with required legal review and audited release; owner/agent cannot independently destroy held evidence.
classes.exportPolicy: Separate lawful access/appeal process; general account bundle excludes raw evidence, reviewer references and operational risk internals.

readers: Restricted reviewed evidence/correction handlers; no general customer/model disclosure
processors: Risk sampling uses scoped metadata; future response operations require separate approval
remainingExposure: Incident metadata is sensitive; separate restricted evidence/preservation operations remain incomplete.

classes.purpose: Untrusted imported source awaiting policy/security admission.
classes.currentRetention: Stored source/digest/triage state; hourly triage never approves. No age cleanup; owner/project deletion cascades.
classes.proposedRetention: Ordinary abandoned pending imports: proposed seven days after last user activity, after ruling out open scan/case preservation. Never activate or export held source to bypass admission.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner removal/closure or approved quarantine policy, after restricted-case review.
classes.exportPolicy: Manifest may report a held import without bytes. Only separately cleared artifacts may enter normal code exports.

readers: Exact owner/import preview under quarantine and restricted triage
processors: Bounded source/security triage; no execution/publication before current admission
remainingExposure: Imported source is untrusted and readable in the quarantine store; triage does not imply full safety clearance.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Structured directory records, public snapshots and exact change/export authority.
classes.currentRetention: Current draft/live data and immutable reviews remain with project; no age purge of review payloads.
classes.proposedRetention: Active records until explicit removal/closure; strip duplicate obsolete snapshot payloads only after preserving required receipt identity. Reapply record deletion on restores.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact owner mutation/closure review; identify third-party personal data and lawful request routing.
classes.exportPolicy: Owned directory snapshots/records in a separately labeled project-data section, with current safety/privacy authorization.

readers: Owner records/review/export; visitors only current public snapshot
processors: Deterministic record validation and reviewed publication; selected owner-maintenance context
remainingExposure: Directory records can contain personal details; approved public snapshots and downloads cannot be recalled.

classes.purpose: Customer contact inbox and form admission/idempotency.
classes.currentRetention: Submissions expire after 30 days; inbox hides expired data and daily maintenance removes expired submissions/receipts. Settings and review metadata are separate.
classes.proposedRetention: Keep the existing 30-day message window unless explicitly changed. Closure disables intake immediately, purges ordinary content and retains only justified anti-replay metadata.
classes.deletionAuthority: Project owner controls inbox; visitor privacy requests need verified scoped handling. Customer closure never authorizes transfer to an unrelated account.
classes.exportPolicy: Separate explicitly requested visitor-data export; not default platform profile export, agent context or public site source ZIP.

readers: Project owner inbox via scoped handlers; submitter receipt conveys no general inbox access
processors: Bounded form admission and owner-requested inspection/export; no visitor-triggered maintenance AI
remainingExposure: Contact names/messages are readable private visitor data; notifications/export and model sharing require their own admitted purpose.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Bounded backend source, tests, state, saved snapshots, private capability plans, generated-extension provenance and live authority.
classes.currentRetention: Account/project-linked artifacts and immutable review/operation metadata; some authority references block cascades. Backend snapshots may duplicate submitted personal data. Composition plans expire for new execution after fifteen minutes but have no age purge; retained extension provenance references the plan and prevents premature deletion. Count bounds do not establish timed retention.
classes.proposedRetention: Active artifacts until removal/closure; disable execution and form ingress first. Settle dispatched work; scrub current and snapshot copies and keep minimum replay/deletion metadata separately.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact owner source/state/closure review; worker outcomes cannot authorize new external effects during closure.
classes.exportPolicy: Cleared source/tests and compatibility manifest; private state requires separate explicit data scope. Never include secrets or execute source while exporting.

readers: Owner exact backend/configuration/test/state handlers; runtime only admitted program/input/state
processors: Bounded QuickJS, explicit test/review, selected maintenance context and deterministic public actions

protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Opt-in reuse nomination and provenance of platform-authored reusable components.

classes.proposedRetention: Withdraw pending nominations on closure. Any future shared release must have separate reviewed sanitized/licensed provenance and a removal/correction process independent of private tenant source.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner withdraws nomination; authorized maintainer handles already accepted generic artifacts under separate license/safety review.
classes.exportPolicy: Customer code's component/license provenance; never another customer's source or nomination data.

processors: Maintained component composer; no automatic cross-user retrieval

classes.proposedRetention: Revoke access immediately on reviewed erasure/closure. Retain minimal durable suppression independently of account cascades through every allowed backup/restore window; short replay receipts alone are insufficient.

classes.purpose: Visitor documents, bounded transition outcomes, application configuration and execution authority.

classes.proposedRetention: Application content remains while active; erasure covers result/next-state copies as well as current document. Non-content operation receipts survive only for defined replay/reconciliation needs.

classes.exportPolicy: Separate scoped visitor export; optional owner app-data export needs explicit authority and format selection. Existing visitor stream is not a globally consistent restore snapshot.

classes.proposedRetention: Backups and user-visible saved recovery points must be distinguished. Proposed 30-day maximum for managed backup copies; retained user recovery points must be scrubbed for visitor erasures before serving/restoring.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact owner recovery-point/closure review; erasure suppression overrides recovery content. Restricted holds never make a snapshot publicly usable.
classes.exportPolicy: Separately labeled recovery data only with explicit scope and suppression applied; never export erased visitors from old snapshots.

remainingExposure: Recovery/staging copies contain private visitor data and can revive deleted rows unless deletion/revocation is reconciled.

classes.purpose: Customer-authorized provider access and durable credential revocation.
classes.currentRetention: Encrypted credentials retained for pending revocation until confirmed or expired; OAuth expiry cleanup. Account cascades can destroy revocation authority prematurely. Current source retains unresolved dispatched exchanges without automatic expiry, restricting account deletion and key activation; transient rotation guards exist only inside a transaction. Exact dispatch rejection/revocation receipts contain only bounded metadata and remain until account closure/independent retention reconciliation; a restored receipt alone grants no authority. GitHub refresh credentials use a separate encrypted purpose and RESTRICT references; access expiry or single-token revocation cannot delete their pending grant custody. Numeric GitHub identity is bound once from the exact issued token's authenticated lookup and retained independently of later connections; missing lookup evidence remains unknown. This metadata is not revocation proof. Reviewed app-grant revocation can remove the exact matched ciphertext only after a directly acknowledged, atomically saved 204. Immutable review/outcome metadata remains; unknown effects and unidentified grants stay held. The shared customer renderer and Chat controls are locally verified; real provider acceptance and the coordinated deployment remain pending.
classes.proposedRetention: Cancel callbacks/new consent on closure; revoke credentials before deleting ciphertext/key access. Keep unresolved revocation work in isolated minimal closure records, without preserving unrelated customer content.
classes.deletionAuthority: Customer disconnect/closure authorizes access revocation, not deleting repositories/zones. Operator reconciles failed revocation.
classes.exportPolicy: Provider names, customer connection status and selected resource metadata only. Never tokens, ciphertext, PKCE verifier, auth state or encryption material.

readers: Exact current owner/credential-admitted provider adapters; narrow revocation worker retains only cleanup custody
processors: OAuth PKCE/token exchange, current scoped provider calls and recorded read-only uncertain recovery; no credential in model context
remainingExposure: Authorized Worker plus the retained exact key can decrypt tokens. Local fenced rotation does not establish independent key custody, permitted restore admission or deployed cutover. Unknown provider outcomes retain recovery obligations.
protection.rationale: Database-only exposure must not supply reusable provider access; extend the existing authenticated vault, not customer unlock UX.

classes.purpose: Immutable reviewed source-backup intent, committed destination and uncertain-write reconciliation.
classes.currentRetention: Receipt retains source version; unresolved dispatch and private files_json can remain. External repository commits survive disconnect and platform deletion.
classes.proposedRetention: Settle unknown outcomes; minimize payload after preserving necessary receipt. Customer-owned repository/commits remain under customer control; no implicit deletion or history rewrite.
classes.deletionAuthority: Owner-reviewed backup initially; any external removal is a separate exact approval and capability. Closure only revokes Whumpo access.
classes.exportPolicy: Customer destination/commit/status and own artifact; exclude credentials/provider raw errors. Explain external copies separately.

readers: Current owner exact reviewed destination and bounded recorded reconciliation
processors: Fixed GitHub source-backup adapter; credential access remains in connection vault
remainingExposure: External repository copies remain under customer/provider custody; metadata is not proof of deletion or confirmed write.
protection.rationale: Retain the declared infrastructure/authentication layer and narrow current readers; extra blanket encryption would not remove authorized processing access. Verify minimization and recovery before broader admission.

classes.purpose: Owned-domain verification, reviewed DNS and custom-hosting serving authority.

classes.proposedRetention: Stop Whumpo serving and reconcile owned custom-hostname detach. Retain minimum unknown-operation/proof metadata until settled. Never cancel registration, delete a zone or remove unrelated DNS implicitly.
classes.deletionAuthority: Exact owner routing/disconnect/removal review plus provider ownership evidence; customer zone/repository ownership remains external.
classes.exportPolicy: Hostname, intended configuration and customer-visible receipts; omit proof tokens, operational identifiers and internal reconciliation notes.

classes.purpose: Issued maintained definitions, draft answers, immutable information submissions and separate admitted continuation receipts.
classes.currentRetention: Owner-approved LC-10, implemented in current source but not deployed: unsubmitted form payloads/defaults and drafts become unavailable seven days after the last saved edit (issuance when untouched); hourly maintenance erases up to 100 eligible payloads per pass. Explicit cancel erases its payload immediately. Minimal immutable identity/digest/request-hash metadata survives for replay protection. Submitted answers and unresolved continuations are excluded. Form authority expiry remains distinct from payload retention. Project and account deletion refuse pending/unknown continuations. The account guard runs before the parent user row disappears, so cascades cannot erase unresolved custody. After explicit reconciliation, project deletion cascades content but request tombstones remain until account removal. The current maintained form client expires local unsent answers after seven days since the last local edit, independently retains exact unresolved requests, and clears form recovery on detected account change/sign-out. A server-unavailable form clears its locally edited draft while preserving any unresolved request. Browser/query copies are excluded from PWA Cache Storage. Account-scoped project-intake records do not cascade with a selected project; immutable submitted selection UUIDs remain historical facts with no resource authority. Information-only submissions have no downstream continuation record. Explicit user-requested correction successors carry earlier answers as user-provenance defaults and receive their own seven-day draft clock; predecessor retention is unchanged. Unavailable selected projects are omitted from new defaults, while original submitted facts remain immutable. Project-status card definitions retain only the maintained binding reference under the existing form policy. Read results are private/no-store, opened on demand, never persisted in sessionStorage, history or export and never sent to inference. The mounted query has zero inactive retention, is aborted/evicted on collapse/navigation, and uses the shared account/sign-out fence. Failed, denied or refreshing reads do not show cached project values. Current local recovery also preserves bounded finite numbers, booleans and unique string lists, including zero, false and empty lists. Incomplete numeric or local-time text stays in the same seven-day local draft, not a server submission; explicit request creation validates a separate typed snapshot. Unresolved exact typed requests retain their independent receipt lifetime and account/sign-out clearing. No extra storage class, model context or default is created.
classes.proposedRetention: Extend the existing class lifecycle and LC-01–09 decisions in the implementing packet; retain unresolved effects and independent suppressions where required.
classes.deletionAuthority: Current scoped cancel and the fixed seven-day LC-10 maintenance predicate, enforced by schema constraints. Direct receipt deletion and submitted-payload erasure are refused. Account/project cascades are not a complete closure or independently restore-safe erasure workflow; broader LC policies and backup suppression remain open.
classes.exportPolicy: Current Chat v2 transcript export includes retained unsubmitted drafts with answer revision, saved/observed timestamps, alongside allowlisted titles, defaults, accepted answers, state and correction links. Ordinary history omits unsent draft values, including copied replacement defaults. Canceled/overdue payloads project only removal metadata, before and after physical cleanup. No active bindings, digests, actor scope, preview URLs or approval controls. Whole-account export remains separate.

readers: Current owner, project ownership and current identity on domain/HTTP/history/export reads; no public or visitor access.
processors: Deterministic maintained content/project-intake builders, schema validation, fresh owned-project selection and the existing private preview compiler. Intake submission invokes no work. A later pending owner AI turn may explicitly inspect an exact submitted intake under current owner/feature/task/submission checks; only saved name/purpose, a maintained writing-style choice or a freshly owned selected project ID/name enters the existing agent_inspections record and one bounded follow-up provider request. Draft/default values remain excluded.
remainingExposure: Defaults and submitted text are private content readable by authorized platform processors and privileged operators. The maintained form client keeps edited answers, exact unresolved requests and collapse metadata in account-bound sessionStorage (whumpo.chat-forms.v1), with a seven-day local draft timeout, account-mismatch and sign-out clearing, and late-response fencing. Same-origin JavaScript and browser session restore can access or copy these readable records; unresolved requests have separate retention. Current read results are transient query data and are removed on navigation/reset or the server-reported draft cutoff. Native resource queries also use zero inactive retention and abort signals. No PWA cache or generalized custom-form issuance is added. Selected submitted-intake inspections may create existing Chat/agent-inspection/provider and independently admitted project copies, with existing inference disclosure and retention; current-turn relevance is model guidance rather than semantic server enforcement. Whole-account closure, submitted retention, attachment copies and independent restore suppression remain incomplete.
protection.rationale: Reuse managed-readable project/Chat protection, current workspace admission and bounded allowlisted projections; no additional customer unlock or copy of credentials.
